nodes.label: Blocking + Classifier Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Hard blocking bounds candidates so a pairwise classifier stays feasible at 10M+ records on CPU.

nodes.label: DuckDB Out-of-Core Blocking
nodes.rationale: Joins over 10M rows and 250-300M pairs must run in 23 GB RAM; DuckDB keeps memory bounded and stages restartable.

nodes.label: Kaggle-only Cascade C+B
nodes.rationale: Classical baseline ships alone; GPU embedding and cross-encoder stages add headroom without risking the critical path.

nodes.label: LightGBM Pairwise Matcher
nodes.rationale: Quality tied with XGBoost but trains 3-4.5x faster, which matters for local iteration.

nodes.label: Macro F0.5 Metric
nodes.rationale: Precision-heavy metric penalizes false merges 2x over recall; macro-averaged per Source 1 entity with singletons included.

nodes.label: Injective One-to-One Post-process
nodes.rationale: Ground truth is injective; keeping the highest-probability assignment per candidate raises precision (0.8488 vs 0.8475).

nodes.label: Per-token Metaphone Explosion
nodes.rationale: Generic phonetic codes shared by >1.2M records produced billions of rows and a 75 GiB temp blowup; removed entirely.

nodes.label: Ten Blocking Passes
nodes.rationale: Union of exact-name, rare-token, address-prefix, postal+name, fallback, prefix-5, and rare-token pair/triple passes maximizes recall under per-pass caps.

nodes.label: Decision Threshold 0.925
nodes.rationale: Re-tuned on the full candidate distribution; the 4:1 sample suggested 0.675 but understates confusable negatives.
